desc: The LWRC IC-9K SBR in 9mm is a compact 5.7" short-barreled carbine built on LWRCs chamber ring delayed blowback operating system for smooth, controlled pistol-caliber performance. Its design incorporates a MonoForge upper, 3.5" M-LOK handguard, and fully ambidextrous lower for intuitive handling in close-quarters settings. With its 27+1 capacity and lightweight 5 lb profile, the platform provides a maneuverable 9mm SBR suited for dynamic use.
